class ReleaseLaunchQualifierSourceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_original_26_ids_and_21_plus_5_groups_are_retained(self):
        ids = []
        for group, expected in zip(qualification.GROUPS, (21, 5)):
            suite, loaded = qualification.load_suite(group)
            self.assertEqual(len(loaded), expected)
            self.assertEqual([test.id() for test in qualification.flatten(suite)], loaded)
            ids.extend(loaded)
        self.assertEqual(len(ids), len(set(ids)))
        self.assertEqual(set(ids), set(qualification.EXPECTED_IDS))
        self.assertEqual(tuple(qualification.GROUPS), ('local-observations', 'required-ptrace'))
        self.assertEqual((qualification.GROUP_SECONDS, qualification.CLEANUP_SECONDS,
                          qualification.COMPILE_SECONDS, qualification.CAPACITY), (1800, 5, 20, 1048576))

    def test_all_original_business_assertions_and_limits_are_byte_preserved(self):
        raw = (ROOT / qualification.TEST_SOURCE).read_bytes()
        lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
        observed = {}
        for cls in ast.parse(raw).body:
            if not isinstance(cls, ast.ClassDef):
                continue
            for method in cls.body:
                if not isinstance(method, ast.FunctionDef) or not method.name.startswith('test_'):
                    continue
                name = qualification.MODULE + '.' + cls.name + '.' + method.name
                body = b''.join(lines[method.lineno - 1:method.end_lineno])
                if cls.name == 'ReleaseLaunchInstalledAgentTests':
                    suffix = body[body.index(b'        image=Path(data[\'path\']).read_bytes();'):]
                    self.assertEqual(sha256(suffix).hexdigest(), AGENT_BUSINESS_SUFFIX_SHA256)
                else:
                    observed[name] = sha256(body).hexdigest()
        self.assertEqual(observed, ORIGINAL_METHOD_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(sha256(raw).hexdigest(), qualification.TEST_SOURCE_SHA256)

    def test_agent_frontend_consumer_uses_actual_catalog_protocol(self):
        # Compare the real producer route with its consumer, without executing
        # a compiler or constructing any positive cold-authority fixture.
        agent = ast.parse((ROOT / 'tools/build_hia_agent_stdio.py').read_bytes())
        routes = [node for node in ast.walk(agent) if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
                  and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == 'build_frontend']
        self.assertEqual(len(routes), 1)
        candidates = [ast.literal_eval(item.value) for item in routes[0].keywords
                      if item.arg == 'candidate']
        self.assertEqual(len(candidates), 1)
        candidate = candidates[0]
        producer = ast.parse((ROOT / 'tools/build_hia_json_preflight.py').read_bytes())
        mappings = [node for node in ast.walk(producer) if isinstance(node, ast.Dict)
                    and any(isinstance(key, ast.Constant) and key.value == candidate
                            for key in node.keys)]
        self.assertEqual(len(mappings), 1)
        source_name, protocol = ast.literal_eval(mappings[0])[candidate]
        consumer = next(node for node in ast.parse(
            (ROOT / 'tools/qualify_hia_release_launch.py').read_bytes()).body
            if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == '_agent_build')
        observations = [node for node in ast.walk(consumer) if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
                        and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == '_compile_observation'
                        and len(node.args) == 4 and isinstance(node.args[3], ast.Subscript)
                        and isinstance(node.args[3].slice, ast.Constant)
                        and node.args[3].slice.value == source_name]
        self.assertEqual(len(observations), 1)
        manifests = [value.value for node in ast.walk(consumer) if isinstance(node, ast.Dict)
                     for key, value in zip(node.keys, node.values)
                     if isinstance(key, ast.Constant) and key.value == 'schema'
                     and isinstance(value, ast.Constant) and type(value.value) is str]
        self.assertEqual(len(manifests), 1)
        build_schemas = [node.comparators[0].value for node in ast.walk(consumer)
                         if isinstance(node, ast.Compare) and len(node.ops) == 1
                         and isinstance(node.ops[0], ast.Eq) and isinstance(node.left, ast.Call)
                         and isinstance(node.left.func, ast.Attribute)
                         and isinstance(node.left.func.value, ast.Name)
                         and node.left.func.value.id == 'front_build' and node.left.func.attr == 'get'
                         and len(node.left.args) == 1 and isinstance(node.left.args[0], ast.Constant)
                         and node.left.args[0].value == 'schema'
                         and isinstance(node.comparators[0], ast.Constant)]
        self.assertEqual(len(build_schemas), 1)
        observed = {'receipt_label': ast.literal_eval(observations[0].args[1]),
                    'manifest_schema': manifests[0], 'build_schema': build_schemas[0]}
        expected = {'receipt_label': protocol,
                    'manifest_schema': 'hepta.hia.' + protocol + '-native.v1',
                    'build_schema': 'hepta.hia.' + protocol + '-build.v1'}
        for field in expected:
            with self.subTest(field=field, candidate=candidate, protocol=protocol):
                self.assertEqual(observed[field], expected[field])

    def test_cleanup_timeout_is_retained_without_a_second_five_second_allowance(self):
        # Supervisor mechanism only; no native test or actual process is started.
        class Child:
            pid = 12345
            def __init__(self):
                self.waits = []
            def wait(self, timeout):
                self.waits.append(timeout)
                raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(['unstarted-test-child'], timeout)
            def poll(self):
                return None
        child = Child()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-launch-owner-timeout-') as temporary:
            with patch.object(qualification.subprocess, 'Popen', return_value=child), \
                    patch.object(qualification.os, 'killpg') as kill:
                report = qualification.run_stage(['unstarted-test-child'], Path(temporary) / 'stage', {})
            self.assertEqual(child.waits, [1800, 5])
            self.assertEqual(kill.call_count, 1)
            self.assertEqual(report['status'], 'FAIL')
            self.assertIs(report['timed_out'], True)
            self.assertIs(report['cleanup_attempted'], True)
            self.assertIs(report['direct_child_reaped'], False)

def _build(output, compiler, authority):
    from tools.build_hia_core_json_bytes import admit_compile_receipt
    from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost import compile_stage
    output, compiler = Path(output).absolute(), Path(compiler).resolve(strict=True)
    source_path = ROOT / SOURCE_NAME
    source, compiler_bytes = source_path.read_bytes(), compiler.read_bytes()
    before = owner_sources()
    require(compiler_bytes and len(compiler_bytes) <= 1048576, 'compiler exceeds the fixed image bound')
    consumed = [binding(compiler), binding(source_path)]
    if authority is not None:
        guard_authority(authority)
        require(str(compiler) == authority['compiler']
                and sha256(compiler_bytes).hexdigest() == authority['compiler_sha256'],
                'production discovery compiler is not the admitted actual cold B3')

    def recheck():
        check_bindings(consumed)
        require(owner_sources() == before, 'discovery build owner inputs changed')
        if authority is not None:
            guard_authority(authority)

    recheck()
    require(not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), 'exclusive discovery build output required')
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    image, receipt = compile_stage(output, LABEL, compiler, source)
    image = Path(image)
    require(image == output / (LABEL + '.image.bin'), 'unexpected discovery image path')
    image_bytes = image.read_bytes()
    admit_compile_receipt(receipt, compiler_bytes=compiler_bytes, source_bytes=source, image_bytes=image_bytes)
    recorded, observations = admit_compilation(output, LABEL, compiler, source, image)
    require(encoded(recorded) == encoded(receipt), 'discovery compiler receipt memory/readback differ')
    consumed = list({row['path']: row for row in consumed + observations}.values())
    recheck()
    manifest = {'schema': SCHEMA, 'source_sha256': sha256(source).hexdigest(),
                'image_path': image.name, 'image_sha256': sha256(image_bytes).hexdigest(),
                'compiler_sha256': sha256(compiler_bytes).hexdigest()}
    manifest_path = output / 'manifest.json'
    publish(manifest_path, manifest)
    consumed.append(binding(manifest_path))
    recheck()
    report = {'schema': 'hepta.hia.cli-discovery-json-build.v1', 'status': 'NATIVE_CANDIDATE_BUILT',
              'scope': COLD_SCOPE if authority is not None else DEVELOPMENT_SCOPE,
              'matching_cold': authority is not None, 'authority': authority,
              'owner_sources_before': before, 'owner_sources_after': owner_sources(),
              'manifest': manifest, 'native_compile_receipt': recorded,
              'input_bindings': consumed, 'compile_seconds': 20, 'capacity': 1048576,
              'json_semantics_in_hia': True, 'build_and_qualification_still_hosted': True,
              'ordinary_cli_activated': False, 'whole_cli_native': False,
              'whole_native_delivery_qualified': False}
    path = output / 'build.json'
    publish(path, report)
    consumed.append(binding(path))
    recheck()
    return manifest_path


def build(output, compiler, cold_report):
    # Authority must be established before even the output-directory creation.
    authority = admit_cold(cold_report)
    return _build(output, compiler, authority)


def build_development(output, compiler):
    return _build(output, compiler, None)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--compiler', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--cold-report', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(build(args.output, args.compiler, args.cold_report))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Build explicit Linux stdio compilers/programs from matching current cold B3.

The original caller-pinned development builder remains a separate entry point.
This builder never executes its produced ELF or promotes a default selection.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import struct
import sys
import traceback

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if __package__ in {None, ''}:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program, render_assembly
from hepta.hia_linux_stdio import PROFILE, require_profile, verify_linux_stdio_program
from tools.build_hia_linux_stdio_program import PACK_MAGIC, _elf_structure
from tools.hia_linux_stdio_cold import (
    CAPACITY, COMPILER_SOURCE, PACKER_SOURCE, ORDINARY_SOURCE,
    admit_cold, capture, check_bindings, compile_bound, decode, digest,
    guard_authority, observation, pin, publish, re_admit_authority, require,
)

TOOLCHAIN_SCHEMA = 'hepta.hia.linux-stdio-cold-toolchain.v1'
TOOLCHAIN_STATUS = 'MATCHING_SOURCE_COLD_LINUX_STDIO_COMPILER_BUILT'
PROGRAM_SCHEMA = 'hepta.hia.linux-stdio-cold-program-build.v1'
PROGRAM_STATUS = 'MATCHING_SOURCE_COLD_LINUX_STDIO_PROGRAM_BUILT'
LABELS = ('linux-L1', 'linux-L2', 'linux-L3', 'ordinary-B3-regression', 'entry-packer')


def _sources():
    return {name: (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
            for name in (COMPILER_SOURCE, ORDINARY_SOURCE, PACKER_SOURCE)}


def _capture_names(folder):
    return {'compiler': folder / 'captured-cold-B3.image.bin',
            COMPILER_SOURCE: folder / 'captured-linux-compiler.hepta',
            ORDINARY_SOURCE: folder / 'captured-ordinary-compiler.hepta',
            PACKER_SOURCE: folder / 'captured-entry-packer.hepta'}


def _stages(folder, authority, sources):
    captures = _capture_names(folder)
    records = []
    images = {}
    provider = captures['compiler']
    for label in LABELS[:3]:
        path, raw, receipt = observation(folder, label, provider, sources[COMPILER_SOURCE])
        images[label] = path
        records.append(receipt)
        provider = path
    path, raw, receipt = observation(folder, LABELS[3], provider, sources[ORDINARY_SOURCE])
    images[LABELS[3]] = path
    records.append(receipt)
    path, raw, receipt = observation(folder, LABELS[4], provider, sources[PACKER_SOURCE])
    images[LABELS[4]] = path
    records.append(receipt)
    linux_bytes = [images[label].read_bytes() for label in LABELS[:3]]
    require(linux_bytes[0] == linux_bytes[1] == linux_bytes[2], 'Linux L1/L2/L3 fixed point differs')
    original = Path(authority['compiler']).read_bytes()
    require(captures['compiler'].read_bytes() == original
            and images[LABELS[3]].read_bytes() == original,
            'profile compiler changes the complete ordinary B3 compiler')
    require(all(captures[name].read_bytes() == raw for name, raw in sources.items()),
            'captured compiler/packer sources changed')
    return images, records


def _all_files(folder, exclude=()):
    return [pin(p) for p in sorted(Path(folder).rglob('*'))
            if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(folder)) not in exclude]


def build_toolchain(output, cold_report, *, compiler=None):
    """Five actual original-budget stages, with exact cold and full receipts."""
    authority = admit_cold(cold_report, compiler=compiler)
    sources = _sources()
    require(all(digest(raw) == authority['source_manifest'][name]
                for name, raw in sources.items()), 'compiler/packer capture differs from cold source')
    # Both author assets are ordinary pure HIA. The physical profile remains
    # explicit only for programs compiled by the resulting Linux compiler.
    pure = {name: assemble_program(raw).sha256 for name, raw in sources.items()}
    folder = Path(output).absolute()
    folder.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    report = {'schema': TOOLCHAIN_SCHEMA, 'status': 'FAIL', 'profile': PROFILE,
        'scope': 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD', 'authority': authority,
        'source_manifest': authority['source_manifest'],
        'source_sha256': {name: digest(raw) for name, raw in sources.items()},
        'pure_core_sha256': pure, 'compiler_sha256': authority['compiler_sha256'],
        'cold_report_sha256': authority['cold_report_sha256'],
        'matching_cold': True, 'qualification_complete': False,
        'whole_native_delivery_qualified': False, 'default_activated': False,
        'author_and_supervisor_python': True,
        'compile_seconds': 20, 'output_bytes': CAPACITY, 'workspace_bytes': CAPACITY,
        'stage_labels': list(LABELS), 'stages': []}
    try:
        captures = _capture_names(folder)
        capture(captures['compiler'], Path(authority['compiler']).read_bytes())
        for name, raw in sources.items():
            capture(captures[name], raw)
        provider = captures['compiler']
        for label in LABELS[:3]:
            path, raw, receipt = compile_bound(folder, label, provider, sources[COMPILER_SOURCE], authority)
            report['stages'].append(receipt)
            provider = path
        for label, name in ((LABELS[3], ORDINARY_SOURCE), (LABELS[4], PACKER_SOURCE)):
            path, raw, receipt = compile_bound(folder, label, provider, sources[name], authority)
            report['stages'].append(receipt)
        images, observed = _stages(folder, authority, sources)
        require(observed == report['stages'], 'actual full compiler receipts differ')
        require(_sources() == sources, 'source changed during toolchain build')
        guard_authority(authority)
        report.update(status=TOOLCHAIN_STATUS, inputs_unchanged=True,
            linux_L1_L2_L3_equal=True, ordinary_B3_byte_exact=True,
            compiler_image=str(images['linux-L3']), packer_image=str(images['entry-packer']),
            image_sha256={name: digest(path.read_bytes()) for name, path in images.items()},
            input_bindings=_all_files(folder))
    except BaseException:
        report.update(status='FAIL', matching_cold=False, traceback=traceback.format_exc())
        raise
    finally:
        publish(folder / 'BUILD.json', report)
    return folder / 'BUILD.json'


def admit_toolchain(path, *, authority=None):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    report = decode(raw)
    require(type(report) is dict and report.get('schema') == TOOLCHAIN_SCHEMA
            and report.get('status') == TOOLCHAIN_STATUS
            and report.get('scope') == 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD'
            and report.get('profile') == PROFILE and report.get('matching_cold') is True
            and report.get('qualification_complete') is False
            and report.get('whole_native_delivery_qualified') is False
            and report.get('default_activated') is False,
            'strict cold toolchain record required; development records are not authority')
    fresh = re_admit_authority(report.get('authority'))
    if authority is not None:
        require(fresh == authority, 'toolchain belongs to different cold authority')
    sources = _sources()
    check_bindings(report.get('input_bindings'))
    require(report['input_bindings'] == _all_files(path.parent, exclude=(path.name,)),
            'toolchain file inventory differs')
    images, receipts = _stages(path.parent, fresh, sources)
    require(report.get('source_manifest') == fresh['source_manifest']
            and report.get('source_sha256') == {name: digest(value) for name, value in sources.items()}
            and report.get('pure_core_sha256') == {name: assemble_program(value).sha256 for name, value in sources.items()}
            and report.get('compiler_sha256') == fresh['compiler_sha256']
            and report.get('cold_report_sha256') == fresh['cold_report_sha256']
            and report.get('stage_labels') == list(LABELS) and report.get('stages') == receipts
            and report.get('compiler_image') == str(images['linux-L3'])
            and report.get('packer_image') == str(images['entry-packer'])
            and report.get('image_sha256') == {name: digest(p.read_bytes()) for name, p in images.items()}
            and report.get('inputs_unchanged') is True and report.get('linux_L1_L2_L3_equal') is True
            and report.get('ordinary_B3_byte_exact') is True
            and type(report.get('compile_seconds')) is int and report['compile_seconds'] == 20
            and type(report.get('output_bytes')) is int and report['output_bytes'] == CAPACITY
            and type(report.get('workspace_bytes')) is int and report['workspace_bytes'] == CAPACITY,
            'actual cold compiler chain or original limits differ')
    guard_authority(fresh)
    require(path.read_bytes() == raw, 'toolchain report changed during admission')
    return report


def _publish_executable(path, raw):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb', closefd=False) as stream:
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(fd)
        os.fchmod(fd, 0o500)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    require(path.read_bytes() == raw and stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == 0o500,
            'published ELF bytes or mode differ')


def build_program(program, output, *, profile, cold_report, compiler=None, toolchain=None):
    """Compile and pack one checked program. Execution is a separate action."""
    require_profile(profile)
    checked = verify_linux_stdio_program(program)
    source = render_assembly(checked, profile=PROFILE).encode()
    authority = admit_cold(cold_report, compiler=compiler)
    admitted = None if toolchain is None else admit_toolchain(toolchain, authority=authority)
    folder = Path(output).absolute()
    folder.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    report = {'schema': PROGRAM_SCHEMA, 'status': 'FAIL', 'profile': PROFILE,
        'scope': 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD', 'authority': authority,
        'source_manifest': authority['source_manifest'],
        'program_sha256': checked.sha256, 'source_sha256': digest(source),
        'cold_report_sha256': authority['cold_report_sha256'],
        'matching_cold': True, 'qualification_complete': False,
        'whole_native_delivery_qualified': False, 'default_activated': False,
        'payload_executed': False, 'author_and_supervisor_python': True,
        'compile_seconds': 20, 'output_bytes': CAPACITY, 'workspace_bytes': CAPACITY,
        'stages': []}
    try:
        if admitted is None:
            toolchain = build_toolchain(folder / 'toolchain', cold_report, compiler=authority['compiler'])
            admitted = admit_toolchain(toolchain, authority=authority)
        toolchain_path = Path(toolchain).resolve(strict=True)
        compiler_raw = Path(admitted['compiler_image']).read_bytes()
        packer_raw = Path(admitted['packer_image']).read_bytes()
        local_compiler = folder / 'captured-linux-compiler.image.bin'
        local_packer = folder / 'captured-entry-packer.image.bin'
        capture(local_compiler, compiler_raw)
        capture(local_packer, packer_raw)
        capture(folder / 'program.hepta', source)
        program_path, program_raw, first = compile_bound(folder, 'program', local_compiler, source, authority)
        report['stages'].append(first)
        require(len(program_raw) <= CAPACITY - 384, 'program leaves no fixed ELF entry space')
        frame = struct.pack('<QQQQ', PACK_MAGIC, 1, len(program_raw), 0) + program_raw
        packed_path, elf, second = compile_bound(folder, 'packed', local_packer, frame, authority,
                                                  extension='.elf.bin')
        report['stages'].append(second)
        inspected = _elf_structure(elf, program_raw)
        require(admit_toolchain(toolchain_path, authority=authority) == admitted
                and local_compiler.read_bytes() == compiler_raw and local_packer.read_bytes() == packer_raw
                and (folder / 'program.hepta').read_bytes() == source
                and verify_linux_stdio_program(checked).canonical_bytes == checked.canonical_bytes,
                'captured program or cold toolchain changed')
        guard_authority(authority)
        destination = folder / 'program.elf'
        _publish_executable(destination, elf)
        report.update(status=PROGRAM_STATUS, inputs_unchanged=True,
            toolchain=pin(toolchain_path), compiler_sha256=digest(compiler_raw),
            packer_sha256=digest(packer_raw), elf_inspection=inspected,
            executable=pin(destination), input_bindings=_all_files(folder))
    except BaseException:
        report.update(status='FAIL', matching_cold=False, traceback=traceback.format_exc())
        raise
    finally:
        publish(folder / 'BUILD.json', report)
    return folder / 'BUILD.json'


def admit_program(path, *, authority=None):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    report = decode(raw)
    require(type(report) is dict and report.get('schema') == PROGRAM_SCHEMA
            and report.get('status') == PROGRAM_STATUS
            and report.get('scope') == 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD'
            and report.get('profile') == PROFILE and report.get('matching_cold') is True
            and report.get('qualification_complete') is False
            and report.get('whole_native_delivery_qualified') is False
            and report.get('default_activated') is False and report.get('payload_executed') is False,
            'strict cold program build required; development records cannot qualify')
    fresh = re_admit_authority(report.get('authority'))
    if authority is not None:
        require(fresh == authority, 'program belongs to different cold source authority')
    folder = path.parent
    check_bindings(report.get('input_bindings'))
    require(report['input_bindings'] == _all_files(folder, exclude=(path.name,)),
            'program file inventory differs')
    tc = report.get('toolchain')
    require(type(tc) is dict and pin(tc['path']) == tc, 'toolchain record identity changed')
    chain = admit_toolchain(tc['path'], authority=fresh)
    source = (folder / 'program.hepta').read_bytes()
    checked = assemble_program(source, profile=PROFILE)
    local_compiler, local_packer = folder / 'captured-linux-compiler.image.bin', folder / 'captured-entry-packer.image.bin'
    require(local_compiler.read_bytes() == Path(chain['compiler_image']).read_bytes()
            and local_packer.read_bytes() == Path(chain['packer_image']).read_bytes(),
            'program uses a different compiler or packer')
    _, program, first = observation(folder, 'program', local_compiler, source)
    frame = struct.pack('<QQQQ', PACK_MAGIC, 1, len(program), 0) + program
    _, elf, second = observation(folder, 'packed', local_packer, frame, extension='.elf.bin')
    exe = folder / 'program.elf'
    require(report.get('source_manifest') == fresh['source_manifest']
            and report.get('program_sha256') == checked.sha256 and report.get('source_sha256') == digest(source)
            and report.get('cold_report_sha256') == fresh['cold_report_sha256']
            and report.get('compiler_sha256') == digest(local_compiler.read_bytes())
            and report.get('packer_sha256') == digest(local_packer.read_bytes())
            and report.get('stages') == [first, second]
            and report.get('elf_inspection') == _elf_structure(elf, program)
            and report.get('executable') == pin(exe) and exe.read_bytes() == elf
            and stat.S_IMODE(exe.stat().st_mode) == 0o500
            and report.get('inputs_unchanged') is True
            and type(report.get('compile_seconds')) is int and report['compile_seconds'] == 20
            and type(report.get('output_bytes')) is int and report['output_bytes'] == CAPACITY
            and type(report.get('workspace_bytes')) is int and report['workspace_bytes'] == CAPACITY,
            'actual program receipt, pack frame, ELF or original limit differs')
    guard_authority(fresh)
    require(path.read_bytes() == raw, 'program report changed during admission')
    return report


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--cold-report', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--compiler', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--source', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--profile', choices=[PROFILE])
    parser.add_argument('--toolchain', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.source is None:
        require(args.profile is None and args.toolchain is None, 'toolchain-only arguments cannot select a program')
        path = build_toolchain(args.output, args.cold_report, compiler=args.compiler)
    else:
        require_profile(args.profile)
        checked = assemble_program(args.source.read_bytes(), profile=args.profile)
        path = build_program(checked, args.output, profile=args.profile, cold_report=args.cold_report,
                             compiler=args.compiler, toolchain=args.toolchain)
    print(json.dumps({'build': str(path), 'status': decode(path.read_bytes())['status']}, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Public, explicitly selected development backend for fixed Linux stdio.

The actual HIA compiler emits program code and the actual HIA entry packer emits
ELF headers/startup. Python supplies immutable inputs and the original bounded
child supervisor; it does not generate x86 code. An explicit caller compiler
digest is an input pin, not matching-cold or whole-system qualification.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program, render_assembly
from hepta.hia_linux_stdio import PROFILE, require_profile, verify_linux_stdio_program
from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost import CAPACITY, compile_stage

PACKER_SOURCE = "examples/hia_bootstrap/linux_stdio_entry_packer.hepta"
COMPILER_SOURCE = "examples/hia_bootstrap/selfhost_linux_stdio.hepta"
PACK_MAGIC = int.from_bytes(b"HIALNXE1", "little")


def _digest(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _pinned_digest(value):
    if (type(value) is not str or len(value) != 64
            or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value)):
        raise ValueError("an exact lowercase compiler SHA-256 is required")
    return value


def _save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def _receipt(receipt, *, provider, source, produced):
    """Bind outer captured inputs to the actual independently returned receipt."""
    if (type(receipt) is not dict
            or receipt.get("artifact_sha256") != _digest(provider)
            or receipt.get("image_sha256") != _digest(provider)
            or receipt.get("input_sha256") != _digest(source)
            or receipt.get("source_sha256") != _digest(source)
            or type(receipt.get("input_bytes")) is not int
            or receipt["input_bytes"] != len(source)
            or receipt.get("produced_sha256") != _digest(produced)
            or type(receipt.get("produced_bytes")) is not int
            or receipt["produced_bytes"] != len(produced)
            or receipt.get("status") != "returned"
            or receipt.get("source_unchanged") is not True):
        raise ValueError("actual compile receipt differs from captured public build inputs")


def _elf_structure(elf, program):
    """Inspect actual HIA output; these checks do not emit any machine bytes."""
    size = (384 + len(program) + 4095) & -4096
    ident = b"\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01" + bytes(9)
    if (type(elf) is not bytes or not 4096 <= len(elf) <= CAPACITY
            or len(elf) != size
            or struct.unpack_from("<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH", elf) !=
               (ident, 2, 62, 1, 0x400000 + 232, 64, 0, 0, 64, 56, 3, 0, 0, 0)
            or struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ", elf, 64) !=
               (1, 5, 0, 0x400000, 0x400000, size, size, 4096)
            or struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ", elf, 120) !=
               (1, 6, size, 0x600000, 0x600000, 0, 2 * CAPACITY, 4096)
            or struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ", elf, 176) !=
               (0x6474e551, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 16)
            or elf[384:384 + len(program)] != program
            or any(elf[384 + len(program):])):
        raise ValueError("actual HIA packed ELF differs from the fixed entry/segment contract")
    return {"elf_interpreter": False, "writable_executable_segment": False,
            "executable_stack": False, "exact_compiled_program_region": True,
            "file_bytes": size, "entry_offset": 232, "program_offset": 384,
            "source_extent": 0, "output_extent": CAPACITY,
            "workspace_extent": CAPACITY}


def build_linux_stdio_program(program, output, *, profile, compiler,
                              compiler_sha256):
    """Build, never execute, a new ELF under the original 20s/1MiB child limits."""
    require_profile(profile)
    checked = verify_linux_stdio_program(program)
    source = render_assembly(checked, profile=PROFILE).encode("utf-8")
    compiler_path = Path(compiler)
    expected = _pinned_digest(compiler_sha256)
    compiler_raw = compiler_path.read_bytes()
    if not 0 < len(compiler_raw) <= CAPACITY or _digest(compiler_raw) != expected:
        raise ValueError("caller compiler bytes differ from the explicit pin")
    packer_source = (ROOT / PACKER_SOURCE).read_bytes()
    profile_source = (ROOT / COMPILER_SOURCE).read_bytes()
    # Packer is ordinary, pure Core; its public admission must not acquire I/O.
    packer_checked = assemble_program(packer_source)
    root = Path(output)
    root.mkdir(parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    report = {"schema": "hepta.hia.linux-stdio-build.v1", "profile": PROFILE,
              "scope": "EXPLICIT_PINNED_DEVELOPMENT_COMPILER",
              "matching_cold": False, "whole": False,
              "public_core_or_code_authority": False,
              "compiler_provenance_qualified": False,
              "author_and_supervisor_python": True,
              "program_sha256": checked.sha256, "source_sha256": _digest(source),
              "compiler_sha256": expected,
              "profile_compiler_source_sha256": _digest(profile_source),
              "packer_source_sha256": _digest(packer_source),
              "packer_core_sha256": packer_checked.sha256,
              "limits": {"compile_seconds": 20, "output_bytes": CAPACITY,
                         "workspace_bytes": CAPACITY}, "stages": []}
    captured = root / "captured-compiler.image.bin"
    captured.write_bytes(compiler_raw)
    captured.chmod(0o400)
    (root / "program.hepta").write_bytes(source)
    (root / "packer.hepta").write_bytes(packer_source)
    try:
        program_image, first = compile_stage(root, "program", captured, source)
        program_raw = program_image.read_bytes()
        _receipt(first, provider=compiler_raw, source=source, produced=program_raw)
        report["stages"].append(first)
        _save(root / "PARTIAL.json", report)
        packer_image, second = compile_stage(root, "packer", captured, packer_source)
        packer_raw = packer_image.read_bytes()
        _receipt(second, provider=compiler_raw, source=packer_source, produced=packer_raw)
        report["stages"].append(second)
        _save(root / "PARTIAL.json", report)
        if len(program_raw) > CAPACITY - 384:
            raise ValueError("program leaves no room for the fixed ELF entry")
        frame = struct.pack("<QQQQ", PACK_MAGIC, 1, len(program_raw), 0) + program_raw
        elf, third = compile_stage(root, "packed", packer_image, frame,
                                   output_extension=".elf.bin")
        elf_raw = elf.read_bytes()
        _receipt(third, provider=packer_raw, source=frame, produced=elf_raw)
        report["stages"].append(third)
        report["elf_inspection"] = _elf_structure(elf_raw, program_raw)
        # Complete input rechecks are additional to each child's own pins.
        if (compiler_path.read_bytes() != compiler_raw or captured.read_bytes() != compiler_raw
                or (ROOT / PACKER_SOURCE).read_bytes() != packer_source
                or (ROOT / COMPILER_SOURCE).read_bytes() != profile_source
                or verify_linux_stdio_program(checked).canonical_bytes != checked.canonical_bytes
                or program_image.read_bytes() != program_raw or packer_image.read_bytes() != packer_raw
                or elf.read_bytes() != elf_raw):
            raise ValueError("public build inputs changed")
        destination = root / "program.elf"
        fd = os.open(destination, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as stream:
                stream.write(elf_raw)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(fd)
            os.fchmod(fd, 0o500)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        if destination.read_bytes() != elf_raw:
            raise ValueError("ELF publication differs from actual HIA output")
        report.update(status="DEVELOPMENT_BUILD", executable=str(destination.resolve()),
                      executable_bytes=len(elf_raw), executable_sha256=_digest(elf_raw),
                      inputs_unchanged=True, payload_executed=False)
        return report
    except BaseException as exc:
        report.update(status="FAIL", error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
        raise
    finally:
        _save(root / "REPORT.json", report)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", required=True, choices=[PROFILE])
    parser.add_argument("--compiler", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--compiler-sha256", required=True)

    report = build_linux_stdio_program(checked, args.output, profile=args.profile,
        compiler=args.compiler, compiler_sha256=args.compiler_sha256)
    print(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))

No assembler, template .S, or opaque adapter image is consumed. The HIA function
owns structural admission, segment fields, startup encodings, relocation and copy.
This is a mechanical packer, not proof that arbitrary input code was HIA-verified.

LIMIT=1048576

IMAGE_AT=384

SOURCE=r'''
def pack(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u32:
    if length(s) < 32 or length(s) > 1048576:
        return 4294967295
    if uint(s, 0, 8) != MAGIC or uint(s, 8, 8) != 1 or uint(s, 24, 8) != 0:
        return 4294967295
    image = uint(s, 16, 8)
    if image == 0 or image > 1048192:
        return 4294967295
    if length(s) != image + 32:
        return 4294967295
    file_size = (image + 384 + 4095) & 18446744073709547520
    if file_size > 1048576 or length(o) < file_size:
        return 4294967294
    fill_range(o, 0, file_size, 0)
    headers(o, file_size)
    start = startup(o, 232)
    if start > 384:
        return 4294967295
    copy_exact(o, s, 384, 32, image)
    return file_size

def headers(o:mutbuf, file_size:u64) -> u64:
    # ELF identity, class64, little endian, ELF version1; remaining ident is zero.
    write(o, 0, 282584257676671, 8)
    write(o, 16, 2, 2)
    write(o, 18, 62, 2)
    write(o, 20, 1, 4)
    write(o, 24, 4194536, 8)
    write(o, 32, 64, 8)
    write(o, 52, 64, 2)
    write(o, 54, 56, 2)
    write(o, 56, 3, 2)
    # PT_LOAD: exact immutable file bytes, R|X only.
    write(o, 64, 1, 4)
    write(o, 68, 5, 4)
    write(o, 80, 4194304, 8)
    write(o, 88, 4194304, 8)
    write(o, 96, file_size, 8)
    write(o, 104, file_size, 8)
    write(o, 112, 4096, 8)
    # PT_LOAD: two fixed 1MiB borrowed buffers, zero-filled R|W/NX BSS.
    write(o, 120, 1, 4)
    write(o, 124, 6, 4)
    write(o, 128, file_size, 8)
    write(o, 136, 6291456, 8)
    write(o, 144, 6291456, 8)
    write(o, 160, 2097152, 8)
    write(o, 168, 4096, 8)
    # PT_GNU_STACK: R|W only, no executable stack or interpreter.
    write(o, 176, 1685382481, 4)
    write(o, 180, 6, 4)
    write(o, 224, 16, 8)
    return 0

def startup(o:mutbuf, at:u64) -> u64:
    # xor ebp,ebp; cld; and rsp,-16. No argv/env or data-dependent entry policy.
    at = instruction(o, at, 60721, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 252, 1)
    at = instruction(o, at, 4041507656, 4)
    # Fixed nondumpable transition, preserving the original native-child guard.
    at = register32(o, at, 7, 4)
    at = register32(o, at, 6, 0)
    at = instruction(o, at, 53809, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 13775173, 3)
    at = instruction(o, at, 12595525, 3)
    at = register32(o, at, 0, 157)
    at = instruction(o, at, 1295, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 49285, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 34063, 2)
    failed = at
    at = at + 4
    # Six fixed borrowed-buffer arguments: empty readbuf, output, workspace.
    at = register32(o, at, 7, 4194304)
    at = register32(o, at, 6, 0)
    at = register32(o, at, 2, 6291456)
    at = register32(o, at, 1, 1048576)
    at = register32(o, at, 8, 7340032)
    at = register32(o, at, 9, 1048576)
    at = instruction(o, at, 232, 1)
    write(o, at, 384 - at - 4, 4)
    at = at + 4
    # mov edi,eax; exit(status); ud2 if the kernel unexpectedly returns.
    at = instruction(o, at, 51081, 2)
    at = register32(o, at, 0, 60)
    at = instruction(o, at, 1295, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 2831, 2)
    write(o, failed, at - failed - 4, 4)
    # Only startup failure is category126; it never calls the HIA program.
    at = register32(o, at, 7, 126)
    at = register32(o, at, 0, 60)
    at = instruction(o, at, 1295, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 2831, 2)
    return at

def register32(o:mutbuf, at:u64, reg:u64, value:u64) -> u64:
    if reg >= 8:
        store(o, at, 65)
        at = at + 1
        reg = reg - 8
    store(o, at, 184 + reg)
    write(o, at + 1, value, 4)
    return at + 5

def instruction(o:mutbuf, at:u64, encoding:u64, size:u64) -> u64:
    write(o, at, encoding, size)
    return at + size

# These two reviewed fixed-width buffer helpers retain the exact existing HIA ELF
# linker's author AST. No old high-level packing function is used as a callback.
_tree=ast.parse(LINK_SOURCE)
_helpers=[n for n in _tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in ('uint','write')]
assert {n.name for n in _helpers}=={'uint','write'}
SOURCE+='\n'+'\n\n'.join(ast.unparse(n) for n in _helpers)+'\n'

class PackerBuilder(Builder):
    def expr(self,node):
        if isinstance(node,ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func,ast.Name) and node.func.id=='copy_exact':
            assert not node.keywords and len(node.args)==5
            a=[self.expr(v) for v in node.args]
            return self.op('buffer.copy_range',a[:2]+[self.cast(v,'usize') for v in a[2:]])
        return super().expr(node)

def document():
    nodes=ast.parse(SOURCE).body;names={n.name:'f'+str(i) for i,n in enumerate(nodes)}
    signatures={n.name:([a.annotation.id for a in n.args.args],n.returns.id) for n in nodes}
    total=total_scalar_functions(nodes);functions=[]
    for node in nodes:

        functions.append({'name':names[node.name],'params':[b.param(x) for x in b.params],'returns':[b.returns],'effects':['read','write','trap'],'entry':'b0','blocks':b.blocks})
    return compact_authoring_cfg({'schema':'hepta.hia.program.v8','module':'linux_stdio_entry_packer','functions':functions})

def frame(image):
    assert type(image)is bytes
    return struct.pack('<QQQQ',MAGIC,1,len(image),0)+image

def generated():
 return render_assembly(document())

def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                      allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def absolute_path(value):
    path = Path(value)
    if not path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in str(path)):
        raise ValueError("explicit absolute path without traversal/control characters required")
    return path


def git(root, *arguments):
    result = subprocess.run(["git", "--no-replace-objects", "-C", str(root), *arguments],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError("source Git identity unavailable")
    return result.stdout


def bootstrap_read(path, limit=MAX_JSON_BYTES):
    """Bounded no-follow read before the runtime's snapshot module is loaded."""
    fd = os.open(absolute_path(path), os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        if (not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_nlink != 1 or before.st_size > limit
                or before.st_uid not in (0, os.getuid()) or before.st_mode & 0o022):
            raise ValueError("trusted bounded ordinary input file required")
        raw = stream.read(limit + 1)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        fields = ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_size", "st_mtime_ns", "st_ctime_ns")
        if len(raw) != before.st_size or any(getattr(before, key) != getattr(after, key) for key in fields):
            raise ValueError("input changed during snapshot")
    return raw


def blob_sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()


def sha256(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def json_bytes(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2,
                      allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8") + b"\n"


def decode(raw):
    def pairs(items):
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            if key in result:
                raise ValueError("duplicate JSON member")
            result[key] = value
        return result

    def invalid_constant(_value):
        raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON number")

    if len(raw) > MAX_JSON_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("JSON input exceeds the preflight bound")
    value = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=invalid_constant)
    canonical(value)  # Reject overflow-to-infinity and invalid UTF-8 as well.
    return value


def read_json(path, label, expected=None):
    raw, metadata = (read_pinned(path, expected, label, MAX_JSON_BYTES) if expected else
                     snapshot(path, label, MAX_JSON_BYTES))

    if (type(value) is not dict or set(value) not in (PINS, PINS | {NATIVE_HELPER_PIN})

                   for item in value.values())):

def source_identity(root, revision, *, allow_dirty=False):
    root = absolute_path(root)
    if type(revision) is not str or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", revision):
        raise ValueError("an exact 40-character source commit is required")
    if git(root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").strip() != str(root):
        raise ValueError("source root must be the Git checkout root")
    if git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip() != revision:
        raise ValueError("checkout HEAD differs from the selected source commit")
    changes = git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all").splitlines()
    if changes and not allow_dirty:
        raise ValueError("candidate source is dirty; commit it or use explicit development mode")
    return {"root": str(root), "commit": revision, "clean": not changes,
